name: ask-form
description: Ask the user structured questions in a private web form they answer from any browser or phone (choices, mockups, sliders, dates, tables), and read the answers back in the chat.

interface.shortDescription: Questions as a private web form
interface.longDescription: When a task needs several decisions or values from you, or a visual pick between mockups, the assistant puts its questions in a private web form instead of a wall of text. You answer in the chat's card or on your phone, and the answers come back as JSON. Forms live on ask-form.xyz and are deleted 24 hours after they close — or, if you choose so when you connect, on your own computer.
defaultPrompt: Use ask-form to ask me what you need before you start.
Use ask-form to show me three layout mockups and let me pick one.
